ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "good morning (the reply)"? (1 mark)
   A. إِصْبَعٌ
   B. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
   C. نَظِيفٌ
   D. صَبَاحُ النُّورِ

2. What does the Arabic sentence مَا اسْمُكِ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name? (to a girl)
   B. I am a pupil (boy).
   C. I am a pupil (girl).
   D. My name is Ahmad.

3. Which Arabic sentence means "I am a pupil (boy)." (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ
   B. اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ
   C. أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ
   D. أَنَا مِنْ كينيا

4. What is meant by listening for the gist? (1 mark)
   A. Listening for the main idea
   B. Repeating everything loudly
   C. Writing every word you hear
   D. Listening only for names

5. What does the ending -ii mean in abii and ummii? (1 mark)
   A. my
   B. his
   C. your
   D. our

6. Which Arabic word means "read"? (1 mark)
   A. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ
   B. ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ
   C. اُخْرُجْ
   D. اِقْرَأْ

7. What does the Arabic word السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) mean? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. Friday
   C. Saturday
   D. yesterday

8. What does the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ (ukhruj) mean? (1 mark)
   A. stand up
   B. open the door
   C. raise your hand
   D. go out

9. Which word means 'I drink'? (1 mark)
   A. ashrabu
   B. uhibbu
   C. aakulu
   D. askunu

10. What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like bananas.
   B. I like juice.
   C. I drink water.
   D. I eat bread.

11. What does the Arabic word خُبْزٌ (khubz) mean? (1 mark)
   A. apples
   B. vegetables
   C. bread
   D. fruit

12. What does ilmis anfaka tell you to do? (1 mark)
   A. Touch your nose
   B. Open your mouth
   C. Close your eyes
   D. Raise your hand

13. How is the Arabic word أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. aghmiD ʿaynayka
   B. ilmis anfaka
   C. uktub
   D. ismaʿ

14. Which phrase do you use to thank the audience? (1 mark)
   A. shukran li-istimaaʿikum
   B. kayfa haaluka?
   C. maa ismuka?
   D. as-salaamu ʿalaykum

15. Which sound does the Arabic letter خ make? (1 mark)
   A. f as in fan
   B. s as in sun
   C. th as in think
   D. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch

16. Which letters can make a vowel long? (1 mark)
   A. laam, miim and nuun
   B. alif, waaw and yaa
   C. siin, shiin and Saad
   D. baa, taa and thaa

17. How do you read the syllable بُو? (1 mark)
   A. ti
   B. tu
   C. na
   D. buu

18. How do you read the syllable مُ? (1 mark)
   A. nu
   B. mu
   C. tu
   D. na

19. Which letters do NOT join to the letter after them? (1 mark)
   A. siin and shiin
   B. baa, taa and thaa
   C. miim and nuun
   D. alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw

20. What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The house is big.
   B. In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   C. On the table there is a cup.
   D. In the kitchen there is a table.

21. What is the theme of a text? (1 mark)
   A. Its main topic
   B. Its size
   C. Its number of lines
   D. Its colour

22. Which Arabic sentence means "I visit my grandmother on Friday." (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا مِنْ كينيا
   B. أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
   C. أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ
   D. أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ

23. Which Arabic word means "bread"? (1 mark)
   A. خُبْزٌ
   B. سُكَّرٌ
   C. طَمَاطِمُ
   D. تُفَّاحٌ

24. How is the Arabic word ذُرَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dhura
   B. sukkar
   C. bataatis
   D. khudaar

25. Which Arabic sentence means "Do not play with the knife." (1 mark)
   A. الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ
   B. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ
   C. الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ
   D. لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ

26. What does the Arabic word حَمَّامٌ (hammaam) mean? (1 mark)
   A. spoon
   B. chair
   C. bathroom
   D. cup

27. What is the name of the Arabic letter ه? (1 mark)
   A. raa
   B. Saad
   C. dhaal
   D. haa

28. What is the name of the Arabic letter ف? (1 mark)
   A. Saad
   B. shiin
   C. faa
   D. taa

29. Which sound does the Arabic letter ن make? (1 mark)
   A. j as in jug
   B. d as in dog
   C. f as in fan
   D. n as in net

30. How is the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. taawila
   B. sariir
   C. miftaah
   D. qalam

31. Which letter is missing in الجم_ة? (1 mark)
   A. غ (ghayn)
   B. ح (Haa)
   C. ع (ʿayn)
   D. ف (faa)

32. What does the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) mean? (1 mark)
   A. drink
   B. gift
   C. no
   D. cake

33. Which Arabic sentence means "I have a gift." (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ
   B. عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   C. نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ
   D. أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ

34. What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my hand.
   B. The banana is delicious.
   C. I drink tea.
   D. I eat rice.

35. How wide should the space between two words be? (1 mark)
   A. As wide as a line
   B. As wide as a word
   C. No space at all
   D. About the width of one letter

36. Which Arabic word means "carrots"? (1 mark)
   A. فَاكِهَةٌ
   B. ذُرَةٌ
   C. جَزَرٌ
   D. مَوْزٌ

37. What does the Arabic sentence يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I wash my face.
   B. My head is big.
   C. I clean my teeth.
   D. My hand is small.

38. Which Arabic word means "finger"? (1 mark)
   A. كَتِفٌ
   B. إِصْبَعٌ
   C. قَلْبٌ
   D. وَجْهٌ

39. What does the Arabic word شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. mouth
   B. heart
   C. finger
   D. hair

40. What does the Arabic word بِيئَةٌ (bii'a) mean? (1 mark)
   A. sun
   B. environment
   C. tree
   D. sky

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Name three verbal cues and say how each one helps the listener. (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into English: haadhaa matar (2 marks)

43. Write one Arabic sentence about today's weather in sounds and translate it. (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Write five foods or drinks in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

45. Translate into English: aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad (2 marks)

46. Spell the word باب by naming the letters in order, and give its meaning. (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Write three classroom instructions in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: maa ajmala l-bii'a (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u ya'kuluuna l-kaʿka (2 marks)

50. Translate into English: laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin (2 marks)

51. Translate into English: ummii tatbukhu T-taʿaam (2 marks)

52. Write the seven days of the week in Arabic sounds, in order. (4 marks) (4 marks)

53. Give two reasons why we should take care of household items. (2 marks) (2 marks)

54. Explain what makes a paragraph coherent. (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Translate into English: ashrabu l-haliiba (2 marks)

56. Translate into English: ʿiid miilaad saʿiid (2 marks)

57. Translate into English: baytii kabiir (2 marks)

58. Describe two things you can do to pronounce the days of the week correctly. (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Write the Arabic greeting for 'peace be upon you' in English letters and give the reply. (2 marks) (2 marks)

60. Explain the difference between kayfa haaluka? and kayfa haaluki? (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i wal-ghaymu fii s-samaa'i. (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Give three qualities of neat and legible writing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

63. Translate into English: anaa ʿinda l-baab (2 marks)

64. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii. (2 marks) (2 marks)

65. Read these sentences and give the day for each activity: (a) adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (b) alʿabu yawma s-sabt (c) aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — صَبَاحُ النُّورِ
   صَبَاحُ النُّورِ (sabaahu n-nuur) means good morning (the reply).

2. A — What is your name? (to a girl)
   مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (maa ismuki?) means: What is your name? (to a girl)

3. C — أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ
   أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ (anaa tilmiidh) means: I am a pupil (boy).

4. A — Listening for the main idea
   The gist is the main idea. You do not need to understand every word.

5. A — my
   The ending -ii means 'my', so abii is 'my father' and ummii is 'my mother'.

6. D — اِقْرَأْ
   اِقْرَأْ (iqraʾ) means read.

7. C — Saturday
   السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) means Saturday.

8. D — go out
   اُخْرُجْ (ukhruj) means go out.

9. A — ashrabu
   ashrabu means I drink. aakulu means I eat and uhibbu means I like.

10. B — I like juice.
   أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ (uhibbu l-ʿasiira) means: I like juice.

11. C — bread
   خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

12. A — Touch your nose
   ilmis means touch and anfaka means your nose.

13. A — aghmiD ʿaynayka
   أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ is read aghmiD ʿaynayka and means close your eyes.

14. A — shukran li-istimaaʿikum
   shukran li-istimaaʿikum means 'thank you for listening'.

15. D — kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   The letter خ makes the sound kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch.

16. B — alif, waaw and yaa
   Alif, waaw and yaa lengthen a matching short vowel.

17. D — buu
   بُو is read buu.

18. B — mu
   مُ is read mu.

19. D — alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw
   These six letters join only to the letter before them.

20. C — On the table there is a cup.
   عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub) means: On the table there is a cup.

21. A — Its main topic
   The theme is the main subject of the text.

22. B — أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
   أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ (azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa) means: I visit my grandmother on Friday.

23. A — خُبْزٌ
   خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

24. A — dhura
   ذُرَةٌ is read dhura and means maize.

25. D — لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ
   لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

26. C — bathroom
   حَمَّامٌ (hammaam) means bathroom.

27. D — haa
   The letter ه is called haa.

28. C — faa
   The letter ف is called faa.

29. D — n as in net
   The letter ن makes the sound n as in net.

30. A — taawila
   طَاوِلَةٌ is read taawila and means table.

31. C — ع (ʿayn)
   The word is الجمعة, al-jumuʿa, Friday.

32. B — gift
   هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) means gift.

33. B — عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

34. D — I eat rice.
   آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

35. D — About the width of one letter
   A small even space keeps words apart without breaking the sentence.

36. C — جَزَرٌ
   جَزَرٌ (jazar) means carrots.

37. D — My hand is small.
   يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

38. B — إِصْبَعٌ
   إِصْبَعٌ (isbaʿ) means finger.

39. D — hair
   شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) means hair.

40. B — environment
   بِيئَةٌ (bii'a) means environment.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Intonation shows questions and statements; speed shows importance or excitement; tonal variation shows feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each cue with its use.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is rain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), aruzz (rice), dhura (maize), lahm (meat), samak (fish).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: I read a book on Sunday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: baa, alif, baa. It means door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the letters, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example qif (stand up), ijlis (sit down), iftahi l-baab (open the door).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct instruction with meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: How beautiful the environment is!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends eat the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not play with the knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: My mother cooks the food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven in order; 3 for five or six; 2 for three or four; 1 for one or two.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: They last longer and save money, and keeping them in the right place keeps us safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sentences are about one topic and are in a good order, so they fit together and make sense.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for one topic and 1 mark for a logical order.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink milk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Happy birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: My house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the teacher and repeat; say the days in a chain; practise the sounds th and kh slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid method.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. The reply is wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting and 1 mark for the correct reply.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: kayfa haaluka? is said to a boy or man. kayfa haaluki? is said to a girl or woman. Both mean 'How are you?'.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy and girl endings and 1 mark for the meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is in the sky and the clouds are in the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each half.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: Letters of the correct shape and same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; small spaces between words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

63. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am at the door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

64. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

65. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) Monday (b) Saturday (c) Sunday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.
